listing.name: Peter Jackson's King Kong Recompiled
listing.summary: Explore Peter Jackson's King Kong Recompiled and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish the original-disc and player preparation
steps.instruction: Use your own original Xbox 360 King Kong USA/Europe multilingual disc, title 555307D3, game version 0.0.0.1. Upstream identifies the 7,834,892,288-byte ISO by SHA-1 075F43709E9C9A095E099AB5056CC04B768288D1. This is a disc-image identity, not a default.xex digest. The 2005 PC version and other-platform discs are different inputs. Finish upstream game import, shader/runtime preparation, renderer/settings changes and any startup/recovery notices independently before attachment.

steps.title: Keep the full independently permitted Windows player
steps.instruction: Use the complete v2.0.10 Windows x64 KingKong folder with king_kong.exe, graphics plugins, DLLs, resources, launcher support and component notices. Do not select the separate easter-egg game as King Kong. Project MIT, SDK, graphics/upscaler, fonts, media and captured-shader rights are separate from your original game rights; attachment neither redistributes those components nor grants permission to use third-party packs. Use only an existing player and optional content you are independently permitted to use.

steps.title: Attach the normal direct-game entry
steps.instruction: Select king_kong.exe, use its complete KingKong directory as working directory and set arguments to --kk_launcher=false. Review the selected program, working folder and arguments and choose Play when ready. This is the normal show-launcher option, not the internal skip-once, benchmark or diagnostic flags. With prepared game files and resolved startup notices it enters the game in the same native process using its current settings. Do not change renderer/restart settings, start co-op handovers or return through a launcher relaunch while attached; close the game normally and perform those operations independently outside the session.

steps.title: Preserve the actual portable or legacy user root
steps.instruction: Windows normally uses KingKong/userdata for saves, settings-owned content, mods, cache, downloads and crash/recovery evidence. Earlier Documents/king_kong may remain the active root if migration fails or the program folder is not writable. Preserve both roots, king_kong.toml, full-path installed.txt receipts and moving-from-documents.txt, cleaning-documents.txt and documents-done.txt witnesses; finish upstream recovery before attachment. Existing user_data_root/cache_root overrides take precedence and must be retained. Do not copy only an executable or replace populated saves/configuration with package defaults.

steps.title: Leave maintenance and extended modes upstream
steps.instruction: Upstream owns imports, shader packs, component updates, portable-folder moves, settings-triggered restarts, online/co-op services and failure recovery. Complete them outside a game session, preserve player data and review/relink changed bytes. The direct existing-player route does not establish full campaign, native controller, multiplayer, captured-shader permission or real-save recovery acceptance. Portcove provides no managed installation, update, backup, rollback, migration or deletion of this external unit.

warnings: Prepare and resolve upstream setup/recovery first, then attach king_kong.exe with --kk_launcher=false. Keep userdata, legacy Documents/king_kong and all move/recovery witnesses. Launcher and co-op relaunches are outside this direct-game route.
